work.title: The workshop
work.content: I like the moment a tangled requirement becomes something you can actually use.My grounding is in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and ERP: requirements, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment and support.From the first question to the last detailI work across teams, connecting the business need with the technical decisions that make it workable. I'm interested in senior and technical-lead opportunities.

lab.title: Pi harbour
lab.content: Some questions are best answered by building a little version and seeing what happens.I'm interested in Raspberry Pi homelab and server projects, AI-assisted work processes, and AI-assisted web apps.A place for experimentsThis island is an illustration of those interests—not a case study or a claim about a shipped product. The appeal is learning how the pieces fit, then making them useful.

human.title: The lookout
human.content: I'm Victor Mendivil. A software developer, problem solver, and a person who likes following a good question.I'm employed full-time. For freelance work, I'm interested in contained needs for individuals and small businesses that fit remote, evening or asynchronous collaboration.Tell me what you're thinkingA clear problem is a good starting point.
